sources.snippet: Role in the pipeline This model is the fast first pass in a larger pipeline: it crops the lesion region out of the full dermoscopic image before handing it off to a U-Net segmentation model and an EfficientNet-B4 classifier. Full pipeline: melanoma_pipline_yolo_seg_class_v2.
